title: A Wet Pup
lines: Dan and Pam met a wet pup. It had mud on it.
"Look at him," said Pam. She ran to Sal.
Sal had a rag. Dan rubs the pup.
The pup did hop and wag. "He is fun," said Dan.
Pam had a box. Sal set a red rug in it.
The pup ran to the box. He had a nap in it.
"We have a pet," said Sal. Dan hugs the pup.
